split_unit: research_v5 connected components of acquisition IDs, exact byte/decoded-RGB aliases, and all conservative similarity links (pHash <=3 AND dHash <=6); similarity links are suspected aliases, not confirmed duplicate labels
holdout_policy: Freeze test references before tuning. Do not load any checkpoint or transfer ancestor trained on validation/test originals.
label_policy: Morphological geometry is a proxy. Structural failure mechanisms require independent expert adjudication and source context.
data_quality_policy: Exp5/6 train and reference evaluation use strict_rc_geometry_v1: exclude any flagged RC annotation geometry/metadata record, retain v5 components and original split assignments, preserve historical data. No automatic coordinate repair or mechanism-label validation implied.

evaluation.preprocessing: Identical real/generated feature preprocessing; document any image-space transforms separately.
evaluation.classifier: Blind to requested labels and commanded masks; calibrate on independent labeled images before interpreting scores as accuracy.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report seed-level spread and per-class Wilson intervals; group bootstrap original images for reference-derived estimates.
evaluation.failure_reporting: Persist per-sample structural measurements before optional fidelity; retain failures and missing-pair errors.

ablations: Class-only conditioning versus class plus spatial fields on the same held-out references
Zero versus correct versus shuffled spatial fields, with identical initial noise
Guidance-scale sweep selected on validation only
Sampling-step sweep with matched seeds and wall-time measurements
EMA versus raw weights under the same protocol
publication_gates: Complete unambiguous provenance and group-isolated manifests
Three-seed evaluations with consistent sample budgets
Corrected reports, plots and website matching verified artifacts
